## Complete Pooling approach

# Make data object
run_data <- list(N = nrow(curling),
                 x = curling$PowerPlay,
                 y = curling$USWin,
                 m0 = 0,
                 m1 = 0,
                 s0 = 35,
                 s1 = 15,
                 alpha = 1,
                 eta = 0.072)

# Fit model in Stan

            data = run_data, 
            chains = 4, 
            warmup = 1000,
            iter = 2000)
